verdict.rationale: Turso ships open export paths — local SQLite-compatible files, a `.dump` command producing SQL, and libSQL as an open-source fork — supporting the ability to take data out in standard formats [turso-docs-29][turso-docs-47][turso-gh-1]. However, a hands-on community report concretely contradicts full 'open format' portability: once any Turso-specific extension (e.g. vector search) is used in the schema, the resulting database is no longer true SQLite-file-compatible, breaking the SQLite CLI, Litestream, sqlite_rsync, recovery tools, and SQLite UIs [turso-comm-8]. Missing for 10: clear vendor guidance/tooling for converting an extension-using database back to vanilla SQLite before export, and independent confirmation that full data (including vectors) exports losslessly to an open format.
